notes.title: Hue Defense Update v1.1 Released
notes.notes:
We add 2 new options in menu for change the game difficulty, we understand the game is... well... hard. We didnt hat a lot testers so we based in our and friends experience, sinse we made the game this made the game more difficulty then it should be, it was our mistake.

We hope this give you a better game experience. We will keep the game difficultys as it is but this new options (if enable) will make the game more easy and confortable, they work with the base systens of minion levels.


[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add (in options menu) new 2 options for change the game difficulty.

[h1]Minion level scale:[/h1]
The minions have a base level and a scale level (how is based in the player level), we made that to make the game keep challenger, if you desactive that will made the game a lot easy sinse the minions level will based only in his level base (*some special minions will still going be on a high level, thats is intentional to make more challenger).

[h1]Collect Items:[/h1]
You can choise between [b]auto-collect[/b] or [b]manual[/b]* collect the minion drops.
*pass the mouse over them.[/list]

notes.title: Hue Defense Update v1.02 Released
notes.notes:
An update to Hue Defense has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Hue Defense.

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add new levels of diffculty.
[/list]

On option menu, you can choose game difficulty anytime!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391997/468e3e7e66a05f8499b97f4ca79ff87519f4bf99.png[/img]

You have three options of difficulty now.

[b]HUE:[/b] On that level the use of right towers and specials are indispensable to success.
[b]Medium:[/b] The enemies have their defense weakened, and rubber gun towers are more effective against elites.
[b]Easy:[/b] Enemies have their defenses and health reduced, and the rubber gun towers are much effective agains elites.


check this guide, some tips to win:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1590525073][/url]

notes.title: Balance Patch v1.01
notes.notes:
[h1]General fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New remasterized stage music
[*]Initial coins raised from 250 to 300
[*]Reduced damage from rubber gun against elite from 100% to 30%
[*]The dizziness effect was reduced from 20 to 10 sec
[*]Time to collect drops raised from 5 to 10 sec.
[*]You don't need to wait drops to hit the ground to collect them anymore
[*]Before, you had to reach level 30 to upgrade a tech skill to level 5. That was reduced to level 25.
[*]Some achievements had counting bugs. Not anymore!
[*]Going back from the world map to main menu no long show splashscreens
[/list]
[h1]Balance patch[/h1]

[b]The meta game is changed. Now, to win, you'll have to use towers creatively and strategically.[/b]

[b]Coxinha, Mandioca Towers[/b]
[list]
[*]Price is reduced from 250 to 200
[*]Reload time base reduced from 3.0 to 2.5
[*]Raised armor penetration from 0.4 to 0.5
[*]LV3 class upgrade cost raised from 1000 to 1200
[/list]

[b]Rubber Gun Tower[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced armor penetration from 0.4 to 0.1
[*]Power x Level is reduced
[*]Ammo upgrade Double Fire cost raised from 300 to 500
[*]Ammo upgrade Triple Fire cost raised from 700 to 1000
[*]Ammo upgrade Multishot cost raised from 1500 to 2000
[*]LV2 class upgrade cost raised from 500 to 600
[*]LV3 class upgrade cost raised from 1000 to 1200
[/list]

[b]Spray Tower[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced power after first ammo upgrade.
[*]Dizziness effect reduced from 3 to 1 sec.
[/list]
